title: Multiply decimals
status: draft: written by Claude, waiting for owner review
about: Teacher-verified mastery check. Written separately from the practice generators: different wordings, word problems, and an 'is this right?' item. Each item is worth 1 point. 'math' is the calculation behind the item, used only by the test that checks the answer key.
directions: Show your work. Check that the size of your answer makes sense.

items.prompt: Gas costs $3.40 a gallon. How much do 6 gallons cost?
Rosa says 0.5 × 0.7 = 3.5. Is she right? Explain, and give the correct answer.
items.answer: 0.35 (No: tenths × tenths = hundredths, so the answer has 2 decimal places; also 0.5 × 0.7 must be less than 1)

items.prompt: One lap of a track is 0.25 miles. Dev runs 8 laps. How many miles is that?
Leo says 4.2 × 0.1 = 42. Is he right? Explain, and give the correct answer.
items.answer: 0.42 (No: × 0.1 is the same as ÷ 10, so the answer gets smaller)
